subject: Commit runway check + stage updates (Q3 readiness)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit runway check + stage updates (Q3 readiness)

Team —

We have three mid-to-large opportunities that are the primary drivers of our Q3 quota coverage for Commercial. I attached a quick spreadsheet (Q3-commit-runway.xlsx) with the current commit numbers and the conservative/likely/best-case scenarios. Please update the Stage, Next Step, and Confidence columns by EOD tomorrow.

Ask by column:
- Stage: commit / commit-probable / commit-weak / commit-pipe
- Expected close date (mm/dd)
- Top blocker (1 line)
- Actions to remove blocker (owner + ETA)

Quick notes:
- We need >=3.5x gross coverage across the book for a healthy finish given the historical conversion rate for these verticals.
- Any deal where Procurement/Legal is engaged counts as a “procurement risk” and needs explicit escalation.

I’ll consolidate and run a gap call Wed 8/11 at 3pm PT to agree on mitigation priorities. If you think a customer meeting should be scheduled before then, flag it in the sheet.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: Q3-commit-runway.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit runway check + stage updates (Q3 readiness)

Laura —

Confirmed; I updated rows for Acme Corp and Polaris with the latest stage and confidence. Short summary for Acme:
- Current committed ARR in sheet: $420k (probable)
- Sales stage: Legal review (commit-probable)
- Blocker: Procurement has requested our data retention & SOC2 evidence; legal needs a small SOW tweak on retention language.
- Action: I’m owning the procurements packet with Markus. I’ll deliver a revised SOW and the SOC2 evidence bundle to Maria by 8/10 EOD.
- Confidence (conservative/likely/best): 20% / 60% / 85%

GAP note: With the conservative numbers, we’re ~2.8x coverage on target ACV for the quarter; likely case gets us to ~3.4x, still shy of the 3.5x goal. Biggest lever: move two probable deals over the line (Acme and Polaris).

I’ve left in-line comments in the sheet where I need more detail from the AEs.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the update and for sending the spreadsheet. Procurement is looped in — they’d like to confirm the standard retention terms and see the SOC2 report Snapshot. We received the SOW draft yesterday and passed a couple of redlines to our legal team. If you can provide the SOC2 export and an updated SOW that reflects data retention options (90/180/365 days) we’ll prioritize the review.

We remain optimistic about a late August close, but the timeline depends on legal/procurement aligning.

Maria —

Appreciate the clarity. Markus will send the SOC2 snapshot and the updated SOW with explicit 90/180/365 retention options by EOD today. Karthik and I are scheduling a short alignment call with your procurement team for 8/11 at 10am ET — does that work? If so, please share any specific legal redlines you want covered off during that call.

To the internal team: after Markus uploads the SOC2 and updated SOW to the shared Drive link (below), I’ll rerun the committed/likely scenarios and highlight the delta for Wednesday’s gap call. Prepare to propose two mitigation plays for each deal: (1) accelerated exec engagement for high-confidence closes, (2) swapped discount/term concessions for procurement friction.

- Acme Corp: $420,000 (probable)
- Polaris Inc: $310,000 (probable)
